criteria.title: Close a full8-message queue while one sender waits and then drain from a surviving grantee.
criteria.task: Close a full8-message queue while one sender waits and then drain from a surviving grantee.
criteria.purpose: Assess this particular ownership, state, ordering, resource or evidence boundary independently.

knowledge: T56.05 teaching and full parent contract
C17 object lifetime, integer bounds, caller/target ownership and declared machine model
artifacts: PR-T56-05 learner source/analysis and precise reused-component identities; absent required implementations remain work

reasoning: Close a full8-message queue while one sender waits and then drain from a surviving grantee.
Derive: New/blocked sends failCLOSED; accepted FIFO data remains available before receiveCLOSED. Destroy requires closed and drained; owner death must not erase a reachable grantee queue prematurely.
State pre/postconditions, invariants, resource costs, failure publication and exact evidence limits. Separate ISO C, original model, compiler/ABI, ISA/OS and physical premises.

deliverables.D1: Unaided mechanism argument and prediction: Close a full8-message queue while one sender waits and then drain from a surviving grantee.
deliverables.D2: Implementation or inspectable analysis with source identities: Actual generation-checked integer channels with close/drain/blocking wake and guest tests. Address this remaining obligation: Copied byte-message spans, directional rights and failed-copy retention remain required. Use X-T56-003 as the bounded prerequisite where its explicitly mapped facet applies; its portable result cannot stand in for the actual kernel adapter.
deliverables.D3: Independent expectation, fresh counterexample and first-divergence evidence: New/blocked sends failCLOSED; accepted FIFO data remains available before receiveCLOSED. Destroy requires closed and drained; owner death must not erase a reachable grantee queue prematurely.
deliverables.D4: After at least7days independently attempt: Create three processes with downstream backpressure and reconcile all accepted, blocked and closed messages.
